Own imported/generated key buffers and honor input-view offsets for current browser WebCrypto types. Require a configured authenticated account and nonempty username before initiating directory key generation/upload; anonymous domain challenges cannot write to the historical default directory.
Own private-key and signing-plaintext buffers for native RSA authentication.
Accept an explicitly persisted main-thread fingerprint in a DedicatedWorker; validate and clone the non-null UUID without adding worker storage globals.

Authenticate the actual queued reliable packets; verify incoming source channel/HMAC and native exceptions; expose current transport failure. Inject the selected peer factory into the native datagram socket while retaining source and HMAC verification.
Deep-clone exact owned datagram views and preserve read/write offsets without aliasing.
Serialize native UTF-8 packet strings; keep a separate QDataStream QString writer for avatar identity.
Use browser-native FormData string/Blob overloads and remove the Node multipart polyfill.
Anonymous clients keep empty native username/signature fields after a challenge and do not initiate unsolicited directory key uploads. Pass the selected peer factory into native node initialization.
Use distinct address/message receive keys; retain no ambiguous decimal concatenation across native channels.
Assemble bounded native reliable fragments once and return exact payload views with correct metadata.
Match native pose/joint serialization and use absolute translation dimensions.
Match current native identity QString/flags and omit the removed attachment block.
Bound native trait values and correctly consume deletion and instance records.
Read the production Qt native header UUID in big-endian order and use a bounded shared node reader for null/Any/IPv4 QHostAddress records instead of assuming two fixed eight-byte sockets.
Share the bounded native node reader with DomainList, preserving short null/Any socket records and rejecting truncated or unsupported address protocols explicitly.
Correct typed inflate input and binary property returns; this legacy decoder is unused by the direct entity projection.
Return owned binary message bytes bounded to the supplied packet view.

Parse bounded received datagrams honoring DataView offsets and the native MTU.
Dispose reliable send queues and their retransmission timers. Release unfinished native receive fragments through the actual failure handler on channel disposal as well as stopping send timers.

Match production native LossList interval membership when removing retransmitted missing packets; actual lost/reordered reliable messages can then complete and cumulative ACKs advance, including sequence-number wraparound.
Use production-generated Overte packet versions/signature, source/HMAC classifications and replicated mapping.

Dispose queues and RTC sessions, bound current receive processing and relay typed synchronous transport failure. Inject the RTC peer factory while retaining native UDT reliability and receive filtering.
Use the production-generated native maximum datagram size.

Own one peer per service, bound ICE/SDP/send data, and invalidate delayed SDP/ICE/callbacks on close. Use cancellable peer acquisition for native or transferred channels, handle already-open channels, reject stale acquisition and expose fixed transfer failure messages.
Own current service/generation maps, bounded receive queues, non-reused pseudo ports and synchronous closure signals. Thread the configured peer factory through current service creation.
Normalize native six-byte quaternion compression and bound damaged quaternion reconstruction.
